# ArDali WebMedia v5.2.16

This draft is sourced from [`docs/RELEASE_NOTES_v5.2.16.md`](../../docs/RELEASE_NOTES_v5.2.16.md). Use that file as the GitHub Release body after CI assets have been uploaded and verified.

## Release gate

- [ ] Linux artifacts built and smoke-checked
- [ ] Windows build checked when included
- [ ] Flatpak metadata validation passed
- [ ] `SHA256SUMS.txt` verified against downloaded assets
- [ ] GPG signature verified when present
- [ ] AUR checksum updated from the final AppImage
- [ ] Known issues and contributor credits reviewed

Do not mark the release as latest until these checks pass.
